name: How long does an interior layout reconfiguration project usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does an interior layout reconfiguration project usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most interior layout reconfigurations take between three to eight weeks from demolition to final punch-out. The exact timeline depends on project scale, such as whether you are expanding a master bathroom or opening an entire kitchen into a living area. Structural alterations, framing modifications, and sub-trade mechanical rough-ins happen during the first half. The remaining time is dedicated to drywall hanging, taping, texture matching, tile installation, trim carpentry, and interior painting. Delays in material selections can extend this schedule.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most layout reconfigurations take between three to eight weeks, depending on structural beam requirements, utility relocations, and finish carpentry details.
